invariants.rationale: The method operates on 'this.layout' without null checks, so it must be non-null before method exit.
Methods are called on 'cache' (e.g., cache.getFont()), so it must be non-null.
Field accesses such as 'style.background' and 'style.font' are used without null checks.
'text.size' and 'text.indexOf("\n")' are accessed, requiring 'text' to be non-null.
